headline: IndiGo Flight From Pune Returns Following Technical Malfunction
seoTitle: IndiGo Flight Returns to Pune After Take-Off
metaDescription: A Guwahati-bound IndiGo aircraft returned to Pune Airport shortly after departure due to a technical issue regarding its landing gear retraction.
aiSummaryBullets: An IndiGo aircraft headed for Guwahati was forced to return to Pune Airport shortly after takeoff.
Reports indicate the flight's landing gear failed to retract properly during the initial climb.
All 192 individuals on board the aircraft landed safely without any reported injuries.
aiContextParagraph: On November 15, 2026, an IndiGo flight, identified as 6E 0623, experienced an operational disruption shortly after departing from Pune International Airport. The aircraft, registered as VT-IZE and bound for Guwahati, was required to return to its point of origin due to a technical fault detected by the flight crew. According to reports from two independent media outlets, the primary issue involved the failure of the landing gear to retract as intended during the flight's ascent. The pilot followed safety protocols to return the aircraft to the runway, allowing for a landing without incident. All 192 passengers and crew members on board were reported to be safe following the unscheduled arrival back at the airport. Technical teams are expected to investigate the specific cause of the retraction failure to ensure the aircraft meets all safety standards before returning to service.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction through reports from two independent national outlets, resulting in a moderate viral activity score.
